blockers.message: Blocked before implementation: task requires §17.3 endpoint:score and candidate pool/member/discussion/monitoring persistence, but the cited canonical files do not define a candidate score/review HTTP path or persistence schema. services/control-plane/openapi/agora_v1.openapi.yaml and agora_v1_3.openapi.yaml have no candidate pool/score route; design-closure-round2 D8 lists decision verbs but says to use the canonical AG-BE-CP-001 route without naming it; services/control-plane/specs/agora/candidate_pool.schema.json forbids additional candidate fields and has no score_components_json, discussion, monitoring, or negative-example fields. Brief forbids self-created route/schema/fields, so reviewer/design clarification is required before code changes.
